steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ rather than creating or searching for an event.
Open the RFQ stage required by the case.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the closed bid is shown.
Record that the prepared vendor bid is still represented before opening withdrawal.
Record the prepared bid price before opening withdrawal.
Open the RFQ withdrawal window from Settings.
Verify the expected withdrawal window is open.
Cancel withdrawal as required by the case.
Verify the withdrawal window closed after cancellation.
Verify the vendor record remains present after cancellation.
Verify the bid value remains unchanged after cancellation.
Verify the event screen has no error or rendering failure after cancelling.
